sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 170. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 20% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies an A.T. Field.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5500
